missions.title: The Glass Meridian
missions.subtitle: Someone is selling the same safe passage to two ships at once.

missions.title: A Choir Beneath the Static
missions.subtitle: A signal mistaken for a weapon may be a request for help.

missions.title: The Hollow Manifest
missions.subtitle: The cargo exists on paper. The danger is aboard a real ship.

missions.title: The Borrowed Voice
missions.subtitle: Someone has learned to speak with the rescue network's voice.

missions.title: The Shattered Wake
missions.subtitle: A station can stop a weapon volley. Can it survive an entire broken orbit?

missions.title: The Tithe of Worlds
missions.subtitle: An intelligence built to manage scarcity has decided to own the supply.

missions.title: The Still Current
missions.subtitle: The harvesters are idle. The charge is still moving.

missions.title: Wayfarer Exchange
missions.subtitle: A route is only useful when someone at the other end receives what was promised.

missions.title: The Quiet Nursery
missions.subtitle: KEST: Averages hide the moment when a root stops breathing. Record the shortest pulse as carefully as the longest.

missions.title: Borrowed Dawn
missions.subtitle: RELL: The sun is not failing. Our agreement about where the light goes has failed.

missions.title: The Open Shadow
missions.subtitle: VALE: Privacy is a right. Silence on a collision channel is a physical hazard. Measure them separately.

missions.title: Harbour Without Orders
missions.subtitle: RELL: The harbour is intact. Its doors are closed by three mutually invalid signatures.

missions.title: False Colours
missions.subtitle: TOREN: A colour on a scanner is not a warrant. Find the original signing chain.

missions.title: The Rubble Covenant
missions.subtitle: ORR: Ownership does not change momentum. We need both records before a tug may move anything.

missions.title: A Garden in Transit
missions.subtitle: VEIL: A seed catalogue is not a cargo price list. Record the conditions that let it remain alive.

missions.title: The Warrant Ledger
missions.subtitle: VOSS: A reward number is not evidence. A duplicate casualty cannot authorise another victim.

missions.title: The Measure of Care
missions.subtitle: DAIN: We need the equipment's history, not a stranger's diagnosis.

missions.title: The Long Return
missions.subtitle: SOREL: Each crew remembers a different clock. Ask who actually received people, not who filed first.

missions.title: The Unfinished Map
missions.subtitle: ORR: An honest blank is safer than an invented coordinate.

missions.title: The Blue Reservoir
missions.subtitle: LERR: Clean intake water says nothing about what the circulation loop keeps from returning.

missions.title: Mutual Shelter
missions.subtitle: TOREN: A promise of shelter is useful only if a ship can actually fit.

missions.title: The Listening Frontier
missions.subtitle: HOLT: Keep weapon signatures apart from survey bursts. A crowded channel does not prove an invasion.

missions.title: An Assembly of Orbits
missions.subtitle: VOSS: A share certificate cannot stand in for the people on the next shift.

missions.title: Under Tow
missions.subtitle: PENN: Matching form numbers do not make these collars fit.

missions.title: The Memory Atlas
missions.subtitle: ORR: A beautiful memory is not a measured approach vector.

missions.title: A Fleet of Neighbours
missions.subtitle: ARLEN: A promised hull cannot protect a corridor it has not reached.

missions.title: Uncounted Names
missions.subtitle: DAIN: Ask the people concerned how their records should be used.

missions.title: The Honest Circuit
missions.subtitle: VENN: A fast time means little if the clock and the route disagree.

missions.title: Small Lights
missions.subtitle: SENN: Small failures become large when every office treats them as someone else's.

missions.title: The Passenger's Horizon
missions.subtitle: SOREL: A fine horizon is useless if a passenger cannot safely reach it.

missions.title: The Kind Distance
missions.subtitle: SOL: A reply means someone chose to answer. Silence is not consent.

missions.title: Cold Reserve
missions.subtitle: PELL: Count what is here before anyone orders it somewhere else.

missions.title: The Magnetic Orchard
missions.subtitle: VALE: A living structure is not a rack of salvage waiting for a buyer.

missions.title: Open Measure
missions.subtitle: LERR: A certificate should describe a fit, not manufacture a monopoly.

missions.title: The Shared Pulse
missions.subtitle: HOLT: More replies make this worse. Listen first.

missions.title: The Witness Window
missions.subtitle: TOREN: Preserve evidence without turning its owner into a target.

missions.title: Public Record
missions.subtitle: SOL: A story that cannot survive an independent reading is not ready to publish.

missions.title: Signed Passage
missions.subtitle: SENN: Departure is a promise. Delivery is the receiver taking this exact consignment.

missions.title: The Guiding Light
missions.subtitle: RENN: A lantern outside your line of sight is not a safe approach marker.

permanentCommissionDecal.confirmationText: Accept the Hearth Compact commission? Its decal will be permanently attached to your ship and carried to future ships. It cannot be removed.

appearance.placement: Paired visible hull service panels near the cockpit; per-hull surface anchors, never on glass, openings, vents or engines
appearance.contrast: Choose the light or dark keyline automatically from the underlying paint

permanentCommissionDecal.persistence: Persist once with the accepted commission. Retain after mission completion, repaint, repair, escape, hull replacement and current-format save/load. Declining and canceling leave both acceptance and mark unchanged.
permanentCommissionDecal.gameplayEffect: Visible permanent commission record only; no automatic stat, legal or hostility change
permanentCommissionDecal.proposalDecision: Hearth Compact recommended because it commissions both settlement routes; a bounded charter is not allegiance to Tithe.

completionClues.label: The missing instant
completionClues.journalText: The recovered timing standard contains an interval that none of the lane clocks measured. Inside that interval, a curved trace repeats eight times.

completionClues.label: The silent voice
completionClues.journalText: The restored Larvaal call contains a reply from beyond the gathering. Its pauses describe a curve, but no Larvaal vessel claims the voice.

completionClues.label: The inward mark
completionClues.journalText: Beneath the recalled seal's ordinary signature is a second imprint: loops around an empty centre, with each loop pointing inward.

completionClues.label: The unclaimed channel
completionClues.journalText: The independent verifier recorded a reply before its verification challenge could have transmitted. Its curved phase trace folds around a quiet centre, as though the receiver were inside a larger listening ring.

completionClues.label: The curve before the fall
completionClues.journalText: Before the mass driver restarted, the orbital recorder traced a loop of inward-facing points around a quiet centre. The curve passes through the same absence described by the other collected traces.

completionClues.label: The unclaimed reserve
completionClues.journalText: The acquisition ledger contains a reserve entry with no owner, quantity or destination. Its inward-curving phase marks form a ring around an unallocated centre; the signature predates Tithe's creation.

completionClues.label: The resting arc
completionClues.journalText: The lattice's oldest meter records an inward arc before any collector was built. The measured charge is zero, but the phase signature still encloses a quiet centre.

completionClues.label: The unbooked window
completionClues.journalText: The first signed route ledger reserves a window with no carrier, cargo or destination. Its curved boundary points inward and matches a bearing outside the published service network.

completionClues.label: The breath between readings
completionClues.journalText: The unaveraged pressure trace includes a quiet inward curl that no nursery valve produces.

completionClues.label: The unlit interval
completionClues.journalText: A photometer records a curved shadow during an interval when no physical reflector crosses its view.

completionClues.label: The shadow with no hull
completionClues.journalText: The passive comparison contains an inward-moving phase shadow without an associated vessel or identity record.

completionClues.label: The unsigned berth
completionClues.journalText: The allocator's oldest signed audit describes an empty central berth enclosed by a curved approach boundary.

completionClues.label: The seal before the key
completionClues.journalText: An older layer in the physical seal contains a curved signature absent from every transponder issue record.

completionClues.label: The hollow mass
completionClues.journalText: One old trajectory record curves around an empty centre as though the missing mass had a boundary of its own.

completionClues.label: The dormant season
completionClues.journalText: The archive contains a circular season boundary that encloses no named climate or world.

completionClues.label: The unwritten warrant
completionClues.journalText: Beneath the reused evidence lies a curved jurisdiction mark naming neither a person nor an issuing world.

completionClues.label: The temperature of silence
completionClues.journalText: A reference recorder shows a stable curved boundary during a period with no recorded thermal source.

completionClues.label: The passenger never booked
completionClues.journalText: The oldest rendezvous record reserves a curved empty space with no passenger, mass or destination.

completionClues.label: The margin beyond the map
completionClues.journalText: The archive's untouched margin carries an inward arc outside every surveyed coordinate frame.

completionClues.label: The dry current
completionClues.journalText: The oldest flow recorder traces an inward curve through a channel that contains no water.

completionClues.label: The ownerless reserve
completionClues.journalText: An early shelter ledger reserves an inward-shaped volume that has never been assigned a hull or creditor.

completionClues.label: The voice outside the channel
completionClues.journalText: A quiet-window listener receives an inward-curved phase trace from outside both recognised transmission bands.

completionClues.label: The absent seat
completionClues.journalText: The oldest assembly diagram encloses an empty central seat with a curved boundary absent from all membership lists.

completionClues.label: The coupling without a vessel
completionClues.journalText: An old interface calibration defines a curved inward contact surface with no compatible hull in its register.

completionClues.label: The place nobody remembers
completionClues.journalText: Three unrelated diaries contain the same inward curve around a place none of their authors visited.

completionClues.label: The formation with no centre
completionClues.journalText: An early dispatch diagram curves around an empty central formation slot with no assigned vessel.

completionClues.label: The unnamed entry
completionClues.journalText: The oldest register has an inward-curved entry naming no person, cargo or owner.

completionClues.label: The tick outside the circuit
completionClues.journalText: A reference timebase records a curved phase mark between two valid circuit ticks.

completionClues.label: The light before the fault
completionClues.journalText: An old utility lantern records an inward pulse before any of the neighbourhood's equipment was installed.

completionClues.label: The horizon without a world
completionClues.journalText: A viewing reference encloses an inward-curved horizon that belongs to none of the surveyed planets.

completionClues.label: The reply with no sender
completionClues.journalText: A dormant relay preserves an inward-curved reply predating every registered household key.

completionClues.label: The unused order
completionClues.journalText: An expired dispatch order defines an inward route to a receiving volume that has never existed in the reserve.

completionClues.label: The root without a stem
completionClues.journalText: The magnetic reference shows an inward-curved root enclosing a quiet centre absent from the visible living structure.

completionClues.label: The reference without a load
completionClues.journalText: A reference instrument preserves an inward-curved response while its test cradle is verifiably empty.

completionClues.label: The pulse before the reply
completionClues.journalText: A passive trace shows an inward curve before either known participant transmits.

completionClues.label: The frame nobody recorded
completionClues.journalText: Between two authentic recording frames is an inward-shaped phase imprint with no camera source.

completionClues.label: The unreported frequency
completionClues.journalText: The independent recorder captures a curved phase boundary outside the cargo controllers' published operating bands.

completionClues.label: The empty destination
completionClues.journalText: An early receiving receipt has an inward-curved watermark for a destination absent from all freight charts.

completionClues.label: The extra lantern
completionClues.journalText: The verified winter relay record preserves one extra inward-moving lantern phase absent from the physical array.

scope: Thirty-nine original campaign designs, use new objectives, dialogs, routes and rewards. Courier jobs and The Guiding Light are project-authored and supply their own completion hooks.
persistence: Use only current campaign identities and the current save format. Start all campaigns with zero progress; persist and restore normal play, including atomic final payment and clue receipts.
acceptance: TOML parsing, unique stage IDs, all-stage reachability, explicit branch convergence, one-time receipt identities and routes checked as design data. Runtime event delivery, mission reload, escorts, transfers, choices, current-format save/load and reward atomicity need implementation tests.
